verdict.rationale: Connect's docs describe driving core operations through the Stripe API: API onboarding with a custom UI, creating split charges, managing payouts and external accounts, retrieving connected-account balances by API call, and webhook events. Agent-friendly access is extended by llms.txt, markdown docs, an official MCP server and a CLI. Hands-on community reports call the integration, OAuth flow and webhooks straightforward. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), a cited API reference page with per-endpoint detail, and recent independent corroboration (community reports are old).
